verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a chat and community platform, but the evidence pack never mentions a first-party AI assistant in Discord. The documented bots, apps, slash commands and the Embedded App SDK are developer building blocks for third-party apps, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
